table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	/*itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end,  */
	 itemname=case WHEN MAX(saledetail.saleitemdescription) IS NULL OR LEN(MAX(saledetail.saleitemdescription)) = 0 then item.name else MAX(saledetail.saleitemdescription) end,
	users.username, 
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	invoicetotal=dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(saleledger.saleinvcode),
	headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	balance=max(saleledger.balance),  
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	custrefno=max(saleledger.custrefno),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = saledetail.saleprice, 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = saledetail.discperc, 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	serverdate=getdate()
	
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode OR dbo.saleledger.sourcesaleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
	
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	/*			saledetail.rowgroup,*/
	saledetail.saleprice,
	saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	saledetail.discperc,
	saledetail.gstperc,
	saledetail.unitsalestax,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username

ORDER BY 
	saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)*/ invoicetotal

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: cashreceived - (Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0))

objects.name: t_12
objects.visible: 1	if(Sum ( (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01 for group 1 ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for group 1) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for group 1 )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )<>0,1,0)

objects.name: compute_10
objects.visible: 1	if(Sum ( (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )<>0,1,0)
objects.expression: Sum ( (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )
